div.p: provision/ is a baseline: it survives delivery, arrives at every start, and loses to a file the user already has.
inbox/ is a hand-off: it is drained while the session runs, wins over what is there, and is deleted from the bucket once delivered — so it is delivered once, not every minute.
Both are copied by a process that has dropped to uid 1000, so a crafted archive cannot write outside the user's home directory.
